method.evaluation: Previously inspected historical seasons remain diagnostic; no scientific promotion. Grade every issued game against v0 and the September 7 incumbent.
method.history: ACT-derived history through 2025; clean four-game inputs, metric-specific QB exposure, symmetric fit; results retention 0.5 once. QB decay uses the fresh input capture clock.
method.injury_coverage: Non-QB availability is explicitly unadjusted. Dated observations do not imply calibrated probabilities; missing reports mean unknown.
method.name: Corrected opening-week conditional draft
method.roster_policy: ACT roster and sourced expected QB; ACT exclusion does not price lost injured-reserve talent.
method.totals: Prior-season PF/PA heuristic; exact scores remain experimental.
